Subject: About your Sigma 18-35 deposit

Hi Aoife,

Thanks for returning the Sigma 18-35. I wanted to write to you personally about your deposit, because I know a deduction is never the news anyone hopes for.

When the lens came back, we found a scratch on the front element. We've kept $160 from your $600 deposit to cover it. I understand this may be disappointing, and I'm sorry. We do believe it's fair, since this goes beyond normal wear and tear, but I want you to feel the decision was handled openly. I'm happy to send you photos of the scratch so you can see it for yourself.

We'd also like to offer something in good faith. If you prefer, we can reduce the deduction to $100 and refund the $60 difference to you.

How would you like to proceed? Just let me know if you'd like the photos, the reduced amount, or if you have any questions at all. I'm glad to help.

Warm regards,
[Your name]
[Company name]
